visual_review.native_light_dark: Reviewed at 48px and enlarged; clear silhouette, consistent strokes, smooth curves and legible intended subject.
visual_review.original_current_comparison: The rejected jaguar has block-like legs, a triangular ear and an angular tail, unlike the rounded cat in the source.
visual_review.changes: Rounded the ear, chest, feet and tail corner while keeping a clear feline silhouette and body spot.
visual_review.construction_reference: No useful subject-specific Lucide match; supplied reference defines the subject.

omissions: Four overlapping legs reduced to two readable leg openings and multiple spots reduced to one; rounded ear, muzzle and tail retained.
